Name: Bog's SVE Trees Retexture
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/LXKYB7d0/retro-bookcase-10.png[/img]

Stardew Valley Expanded has been the one of the highest requested mods to have compatibility with the aesthetic and color scheme of my mods. ﻿Although SVE has open permissions to make mods with and for SVE, i reached out to FlashShifter to double check, and they confirmed! This mod is the beginning of retexturing/recoloring SVE to make it BOGGIFIED. This will be a longer term project.

I highly recommend utilizing Gwen's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] along with DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] with Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt and Grass[/url] to sub in the meantime<3 (This is the combination i am using in screenshots & my own playthrough along with all my mods)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mrDJyLf8/retro-bookcase-11.png[/img]

This mod also does recolor the fruit trees!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/JhpmRYmd/retro-bookcase-12.png[/img]
Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]my other mods[/url] as i have been working hard to turn the entire game into my aesthetic!!![url=https://ko-fi.com/bogwyytch]

[/url]The frogs are a commission from my Kofi for Frog Sprinklers
The bat is a replacement for the Fairy Trinket that was a commission as well! 

If you would like to see updates on my mods or get notified when a mod is published join my [url=https://discord.gg/tCpM2s2wa4]Discord Server[/url]
We have a great community of mod authors who are making mods as well for the goblins, witches, forest folk & ghouls. 

All my [url=https://linktr.ee/BogWytch]Social Links[/url] <---

Again thank you so much for everything. I have been blown away by all your support.
<3
Bog
